title: Caring for a removable denture
what: A removable denture needs cleaning every day, like your teeth. Here is how to care for it at home.
why: For everyone who wears removable dentures, full or partial.
duration: usually 5 minutes in the morning and evening
tell_doctor: If the denture rubs or your gum hurts
If the denture holds less well
If a coating or smell appeared and does not go away

prepare.title: Brush
prepare.text: A separate denture brush or a soft toothbrush.

prepare.title: Cleaner
prepare.text: Soap or a special denture paste. Regular toothpaste can scratch.

prepare.title: Place
prepare.text: Clean it over a sink with water or a towel, so it will not break if you drop it.

steps: Take out the denture and rinse it with water
Brush the denture on all sides
Brush your own teeth, gums, and tongue with a soft brush
Put the denture back in, or place it in a case with water
feel: You get used to the care quickly
Your gums rest while the denture is out
after: Rinse the denture after every meal
Do not put it in hot water, since it can warp
Do not keep it dry without a case
See your dentist usually once a year, since the denture may need adjusting
red_flags: A sore on the gum does not heal for more than 1 to 2 weeks
The denture cracked or broke: do not glue it yourself

faq.q: Can I clean the denture with toothpaste?
faq.a: Soap or a special product is better, since regular toothpaste can scratch it.

faq.q: Why does the denture hold less well now?
faq.a: Over time the gum and bone change. The dentist can reline the denture.

reminders.text: Before bed, clean your denture and put it in its case.
